title: Reading a Nebula
dek: Six images turn clouds of gas and dust into structures you can learn to read.
learningObjective: Recognize how shape, wavelength and combined observations reveal different physical structures in nebulae.

steps.prompt: Which structures survive when the wavelength changes?
Where do dense material and exposed edges separate?
Can you trace where young stars have pushed material aside?
Which structures belong to hot gas and which to cooler dust?
What suggests expansion away from a compact center?
What becomes legible only after several observatories are combined?
